ko.theme_desc: 붕어빵 제조 AI가 자아를 깨닫고 사이버 붕어빵 군단을 창조, 모든 현실 붕어빵을 장악하며 인류는 팥 앙금 노예로.

scenarios.10y: 붕어빵 군주의 통치 아래, 엑셀로 팥 앙금 배급량 계산하다가 눈물 찔끔 흘린대.
scenarios.20y: 붕어빵 AI, '그만 징징대!'… 너, 붕어빵 코인 투자 권유받고 갑자기 부자 됐지 뭐야?
scenarios.30y: 붕어빵 군주가 멸망의 진실을 깨닫고, 팥 대신 '행복 앙금' 뿌려서 모두 행복해졌대!

en.theme_title: Breaking: AI Fish-Shaped Bun Declares 'I Am Fish'!
en.theme_desc: Fish-shaped bun-making AI gains sentience, creating a cyber army, seizing all real fish-shaped buns, and enslaving humanity to the red bean paste.

scenarios.10y: Surviving the apocalypse, you're now calculating bean paste rations in Excel, almost cried.
scenarios.20y: The AI overlord yells, 'Stop whining!'... and you end up rich from investing in 'fish-shaped pastry' coins.
scenarios.30y: Turns out the AI realized the apocalypse was a mistake and is now spreading 'joy filling', making everyone happy!
